description: Cancel acceptance (VF8, VF9). External 202 with no body. The cancel request is keyed by the run ID (/runs/{runId}/cancel) that execute exposed in its Location — VF9: the service can cancel a run only once that run ID exists, and offers no validation-cancel or execute-before-run-ID cancel. Location points to the SAME run resource that execute returned; Retry-After defaults to 10. The backend cancel command handler (CancelScenarioRunCommand.cs) is state-aware: a repeated cancel and a cancel against a terminal run both no-op without throwing, so repeated cancellation is idempotent and terminal runs are a no-op. Clients poll the run resource until Canceled or another terminal state.
